consigna: Three separate recordings, one per day, two to three minutes each, isolating two skills each from weeks 26 to 33. Notes are preparation, not a script.
requisitos: Recording 2: summarising with the conclusion first (week 27) + deduction with *must have* and *can't have* (week 31)
Recording 3: persuading and negotiating (week 29) + speculating with graded certainty (week 33)
No recording longer than three minutes
In one recording, one repair out loud when you lose the thread (week 32)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Recording 1: advise someone on a bureaucratic problem, hedging only as far as your evidence goes.
*Wed (10 min).* Recording 2: summarise something you read, then work out what must have happened behind it.
*Fri (10 min).* Recording 3: negotiate a shared decision and predict how it will go.
autochequeo: Was the hedging careful or evasive?
Did the summary start with the conclusion?
Were the deductions based on evidence?
Did I repair out loud instead of starting over?
promptCorreccion: These are three separate short productions with two skills each. (1) For each, say whether both skills are present and well done. (2) Tell me which one collapsed under the pressure of speaking. (3) Give me one sentence combining hedging and deduction. Correct nothing else. ---
